figures.before: Class IV Barrier Construction: What "Full Barrier" Means
figures.alt: Occupied hospital expansion corridor with sealed ICRA partition, negative-air machine, clean hospital circulation, and organized temporary protection
figures.caption: A full barrier is an operating control, not a decorative partition. It has to be continuous, maintained, coordinated with air management and access, and verified before the surrounding space is exposed to construction activity.

figures.alt: Healthcare construction containment documentation setup with clean protection materials, inspection checklist, and controlled work-zone entry
figures.caption: Documentation supports the handoffs that keep healthcare renovation controlled: risk assessment, barrier checks, pressure or air-control verification, cleaning, inspections, releases, and changes in the work plan.
